page.overview:
What is Ny-Rakath?

Ny-Rakath is a fictional entity created by Chaosium, which features in the Mythos collectible card game.

Ny-Rakath is a Great Old One who resembles a hulking winged bipedal goat with four horns and a serpentine tongue, similar in appearance to the entity depicted on the Devil card of the traditional A.E. Waite Tarot deck.

Its effect was to eliminate and prevent the use of assistant character cards. Its location was listed as Underground.

Category:Great Old Ones Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
